card.sig_covers: compact envelope {did,schema,surface,as_of,sha256}; sha256 is the whole-card digest, so the signature binds subject, source_urls, tags, unmeasured and payload through it

points.note: the census carries no detection reading yet; every detectable slot is UNMEASURED
a reading before the Article 111(4) date, so two readings exist either side of it
a reading dated 2026-12-02, the date Article 111(4) itself names
the same bytes one week later, so a change in detection is visible
a reading every quarter; a detection reading decays as manifests expire

triggers.rule: A reading is due now if the sha256 of the census file differs from the pinned digest, whatever the calendar says.
A reading is due now if the version of any named detection method differs from the version recorded in the reading it supersedes.

law.pre_existing_systems_basis: Article 111(4) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, as added by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 Article 1(39)(b) (OJ L, 24.7.2026; in force 27 July 2026)

unmeasured: this is a schedule of readings, not a compliance calendar; due means due, not met and not unmet
the census this schedule pins carries no detection reading yet, so every detectable slot is UNMEASURED
DETECTED and NOT DETECTED describe what a named method can read in a given set of bytes at a given time; they say nothing about any other output, method or moment
the C2PA manifest store and IPTC metadata are the only mark kinds this pack reads; no watermark, fingerprint or other kind of mark is read
metadata is often stripped when a file is re-saved, so a NOT DETECTED reading is a fact about those bytes and not about the system that made them
